scripts.local: npm run local:db && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:local:api" "npm:local:web"
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U showspark -d showspark
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U showspark -d showspark -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: dbmate drop && dbmate up && npm run db:seed
scripts.local:api: cd apps/api && venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir src --port 8000 --env-file env/.env.local
scripts.gen:api-types: mkdir -p packages/api-types && cd apps/api && PYTHONPATH=src APP_ENV=local DATABASE_URL=postgres://unused venv/bin/python scripts/export_openapi.py > ../../packages/api-types/openapi.json && cd ../.. && openapi-typescript packages/api-types/openapi.json -o packages/api-types/schema.d.ts
